findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_promote_studio_fork · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_collaborate_on_fork.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_promote_studio_fork · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_collaborate_on_fork

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
